_doc: Owner-ruled exclusions for gate 4 (scripts/fgp_gate4_chooser_validation.py, rule R2d): FGP rows that are not transcriptions of a manuscript and that no general rule catches. Keyed on the durable key <unit_table>:<unit_id>|<sys_id>|<c_number>; a today row is excluded from the candidate, a new row is held. Every key must name a row of today's sidecar or of gate 3's new rows, or check C9 fails. Reasons: non_manuscript (a document that is not a manuscript's text), keyboard_dummy (keyboard noise filed as a transcription). Ruled 2026-10-26 after the Codex review of the candidate; FGP_CHOOSER_VALIDATION_RULES.md.
